fields.note: Department tabs (ul.departments-list) filter the already-loaded grouped Lever response client-side.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: India page has a location dropdown (ul.location-list); the Lever postings API also honours location= (verified exact match).

fields.label: Commitment
fields.note: categories.commitment in the Lever payload; no commitment control was verified.

notes: Both the US entry and the India 'work with us' page ship the same request, https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/zeta?group=team&mode=json, and partition the 28 postings by country in the browser (US: country != IN, India: country == IN). Department tabs and the #searchRole keyword box filter the rendered rows client-side. The Lever postings API itself accepts location: ?mode=json&location=Bangalore returned exactly the single Bangalore posting, so native_query is true for location only; keyword and team filtering remain local.
